topicName: Explain the concept of caching in JPA. What are the different levels of caching?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the concept of caching in JPA. What are the different levels of caching?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Caching in JPA is a mechanism to improve application performance by storing frequently accessed data in memory. This reduces the number of database hits, leading to faster retrieval times. JPA defines two levels of caching: first-level cache (persistence context) and second-level cache (shared cache)."}]
